upstream.description: Graphs that teach > graphs that impress. Turn any code into an interactive knowledge graph you can explore, search, and ask questions about. Works with Claude Code, Codex, Cursor, Copilot, Gemini CLI, and more.

classification.analysis: Understand Anything is a multi-platform coding-agent plugin/skill (native for Claude Code, plus installers for Codex, Cursor, Copilot, Gemini CLI, and a dozen more) that runs a multi-agent pipeline to build an interactive knowledge graph of a codebase's files, functions, classes, and dependencies, then serves it through a searchable, zoomable web dashboard. It targets developers onboarding to large or unfamiliar codebases, offering guided tours, diff-impact analysis, business-domain-flow views, and chat-style Q&A (`/understand-chat`) over the graph, with incremental re-analysis to control token cost. Very actively developed with a large plans/specs archive and strong adoption (79k+ stars).

use_cases.title: Generate an interactive knowledge graph to onboard onto a large codebase
Ask an agent plain-English questions about how a system works
Analyze the impact of a diff before committing changes
Install a codebase-understanding skill across Claude Code, Cursor, and Copilot
